body.x: CES 2020, the world's largest technology exhibition, was held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10, and Seoul Metropolitan City helped 20 Seoul-based innovative companies enter the global market with the introduction of the advanced Smart City & Smart Life of Seoul.

A total of 20 innovative companies based in Seoul participated in the exhibition, running the pitching stage to present their innovative technologies and exclusive counseling space for business meetings.
PiQuant, a specialist in precision optics,introduced AIRQuant, a measurement solution that can measure pm0.5 ultrafinedust, which is lower than ultrafine dust.
This product can measure ultrafine dust ofpm0.5, even lower than pm1.0, and can be used for high-quality air cleaners. Itcan be used in industrial sites for it can measure TVOC in ppm of ±3%.
Smart Diagnosis has introduced the application called CardiVu, which can measure stress indices through pupil movement.

This solution measures the stress index based on heart rate and heart variability through the pupil movement, and can collect and manage the data with the app, and self-diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases or remote diagnosis of mental illness patients can be done. The clinical trial is scheduled to be held at St. Mary's Hospital in March this year.
LUPLE unveiled its AI digital caffeine device sharing the same name that delivers caffeine effects without coffee or energy drinks.

This product is a digital caffeine product developed for those who drink coffee or energy drinks to wake up, but are concerned about addiction. The LED light itself has an awakening effect, and it recognizes human behavior with camera and adjusts illuminance and color temperature to create an optimal use environment.
Perfitt introduced the service with the same name that collects information on the shoe size that varies according to brands and recommends the optimal size.

It is a recommendation service to solve the problem of finding the right size, which is the biggest reason for returning the shoes purchased through the shopping mall, and measures the foot size of the customers for the optimal size, and provides news on the new and popular design.
Irisys introduced the door lock IFP-7070that opens by recognition of faces and hand shape based on deep learning.

This product can shoot at a distance ofabout 1m, which is farther than iris recognition, and can be used byrecognizing hand and palm. It even takes photos of strangers who have madeattempts to open the door more than five times, helping in preventing crime.

With Smart City & Smart Life as the main theme, Seoul Metropolitan City is planning to build Digital Citizen Mayor Room that shows 16 million administrative data in traffic, fire prevention, and environment of Seoul in real time, and thus boosting exports with the data-based administrative system.
